negative_reviews.author: Scott
negative_reviews.text: First of all, I was served before the rest of my family which is not something restaurants do ever, my noodle bowl had maybe 3 small bits of steak, the "bubble tea" was not even close to how it was advertised, it came in a plastic bob and berts cup 😳. The karaage chicken was horrible, the noodles were clearly pre heated grey pre packaged crap. All for 72 quid, won't be back.

negative_reviews.author: Ant Duthoit
negative_reviews.text: Pretty fake, looks about right but loaded with sugar and fat and then loses the taste that proper Japanese food has.
